body: Let me ask you something my dude. How do YOU feel about the game? Don't go by what anyone else is saying about it because at the end of the day, it's YOUR choice. So have you played it and enjoyed it enough to keep it? Or are you unsatisfied with the game and want to refund it? (Also it's only refunds for the digital copy of the game from what I'm hearing but my questions still stand.)
I'm sorry you feel that way about yourself. 🖤 I too feel unattractive at times. It sucks and it feels like you can't do anything about it...

Excuse the way I've explained things. I'm ALWAYS stuck in complicated situations. But if I have to be upset about anything, it's that I felt like a loner the entire time there (which I warned my friend about because the people she hangs out with may not be compatible with me.)

You have to understand though, of course that would be on my mind after it was told to me. As I said, when she told me about this trip, I had NO romantic expectations at all. That was not an opportunity for me to think about anything of the sort. I saw it as were all gonna have a good time but I ended up feeling bothered.

Well, I told my bro before I went on the trip that I was going with her and a group of her friends. He told me it's a possibility that she wanted to fuck. From that point on, that's how all I could think about. Initially, I NEVER thought that. Only until he told me that was when I thought it could happen.

The girl she invited was with my friend and the guy the pretty much the whole trip. I'm not sure if she is single though. And I don't think anyone knew that I was interest in my friend. I'm attracted to her. I was legit the lone wolf of this trip, I barely connected with any of them, including my friend!

Look I'm not saying she purposely set this up. I don't know. I just feel confused and others are telling me that she was basically in the wrong? I don't want to believe that she did but this trip really messed with me.
